thread:
Marta (partnerships): Heads-up — CoreWeave sent updated capacity + pricing for our reserved vs spot mixes for Q3/Q4. Need quick inputs for the cost model before EOD.
Chad (finance): cool, drop the numbers here.
CoreWeave Sales: FYI — skimming the key points: 1) committed reservations available in 3 windows (3mo / 12mo / 36mo) with escalating discounts; 2) spot inventory varies by region, typical discount range 40-65% vs on-demand; 3) preemption rates spike during runouts ~12-20% on avg.
Marta (partnerships): Past conversation had us assume ~50% spot discount and 10% preempt for modeling. These new ranges change things. Alex, can infra tolerate higher preempt?
Alex (infra): we can handle up to ~25% preempt if we increase checkpoint frequency + fallback to smaller cached models. Latency SLOs may degrade for tail requests.
Gina (product): need clear blended per-token cost outputs for hosted vs dedicated customers. If spot share increases, what do we credibly promise?
Chad (finance): give me a simple table — month | reserved_nodes | spot_nodes | spot_discount | preempt_rate | committed_price_usd | est_blended_usd_per_1k_tokens — I can plug into the model.
CoreWeave Sales: pasted CSV snippet from their sheet (cleaned):
```
month,reserved_nodes,spot_nodes,spot_discount,preempt_rate,commit_price_per_gpu_hr
2026-07,40,60,0.55,0.15,1.10
2026-08,60,40,0.50,0.12,1.05
2026-09,80,20,0.45,0.10,1.00
2026-10,100,0,0.00,0.00,0.95
```
Marta (partnerships): note Q4 shows ramp to reserved-only for guaranteed enterprise windows (they offered a 12% additional discount if we commit 12 months for Q4 capacity).
Chad (finance): thanks — I'll model two scenarios: conservative (70% reserved, 30% spot) and aggressive spot (50/50). Need per-gpu-hr conversion to tokens. Alex, what's our tokens per GPU-hour assumption for typical gen workload?
Alex (infra): for steady-state text gen w/ 8k context, use 1.2M tokens/GPU-hr baseline; for chat-heavy low-latency use, ~800k tokens/GPU-hr. Use both as ranges.
Gina (product): we'll surface both in the pricing doc: hosted API unit cost band and recommended customer-facing reserved plan threshold.
procurement-bot: noted — action item created: PROC-1423 "Model CW price bands and preempt impact" assigned to Chad, due 2026-05-09.
Marta (partnerships): Chad, if you can drop the blended USD/1k tokens numbers here by EOD, I'll take them into the go-to-market pricing brief. Also ask CoreWeave if the extra 12% Q4 discount is binding or conditional on usage.
Chad (finance): on it — will post a short table in ~3 hours. :clock3: 
CoreWeave Sales: quick add — we can front-load reserved ramp if you sign Q3 commit by next week; otherwise spot supply may reduce in Aug. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Marta (partnerships): got it. tagging @legal for review if we go firm on the Q3 commit. :eyes:
Gina (product): thanks team — helps clarify whether we recommend a marketplace SKU that mixes spot + reserved or a firm reserved-only enterprise SKU.
Marta (partnerships): end of thread for now — will re-open when Chad posts the blended numbers.
